mode.title: Mode
mode.description: best = the best rate per bank for your filters (ranked); rates = every matching rate row; changes = rate changes since a date or your last run; products = one row per product with its rate range; brands = the list of banks and lenders we cover.

categories.title: Product categories
categories.description: Which products to look at. Leave empty for all categories.

brands.title: Banks / lenders
brands.description: Only these brands: part of the name ("commbank", "ing", "macquarie") or a brand id from mode "brands". Leave empty for all 240+.

industries.title: Banks or non-bank lenders
industries.description: Limit to banks (ADIs) or non-bank lenders. Empty = both.

termMonths.title: Terms (months)
termMonths.description: Term deposit or fixed-rate terms to keep, in months, e.g. [12] or [3, 6, 12]. Ranges like 286-315 days match when the term falls inside. Rows without a term (variable rates) are dropped when this is set.

rateTypes.title: Rate types
rateTypes.description: E.g. FIXED, VARIABLE, BONUS, INTRODUCTORY, PURCHASE. Empty: "best" compares headline rates (fixed, variable, market-linked, card purchase); "rates" returns every type.

repaymentType.title: Repayment type
repaymentType.description: Home loans: principal and interest, or interest only.

lvr.title: Loan-to-value ratio (LVR)
lvr.description: Keep rates whose LVR band covers this value: 80 or 0.8 both mean 80%.

amount.title: Amount (AUD)
amount.description: Deposit or loan amount: keeps rates whose balance/loan band covers it.

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: auto: deposits highest rate first, loans lowest comparison rate first (best mode). rates mode keeps the natural order unless you pick one.

topPerBrand.title: Top rates per bank (best mode)
topPerBrand.description: How many rates to keep per bank in "best" mode. 0 = all matching rates, ranked.

includeRiskBasedRates.title: Include "from" and credit-band rates (best mode)
includeRiskBasedRates.description: Loans priced by credit profile often publish only a minimum ("from") rate, a maximum rate or one rate per credit band. Best mode leaves them out, because few applicants get the minimum. Turn on to rank them too. Every row says what its rate stands for in rateBasis.

maxItems.title: Max results
maxItems.description: Stop after this many rows. Every home loan rate is ~15,800 rows, the whole market ~28,500.

changedSince.title: Changed since
changedSince.description: Mode "changes": a date (2026-09-01) or "last-run" for everything since your previous run with the same input. Empty = last 7 days.

rateHistoryDays.title: Rate history (days)
rateHistoryDays.description: Attach each rate's changes from the last N days (rateHistory). 0 = off.

maxAgeHours.title: Max data age (hours)
maxAgeHours.description: We refresh every product daily. Older data is still served, with a warning in the run summary.

includeRaw.title: Include raw CDR payload
includeRaw.description: Add the product's original CDR JSON (large).
